big_case.notes: The staged OCR application concerns preservation of a family home and an asserted federal due-process defect in Maryland appellate procedure. Stakes are substantial for the applicant, but the requested relief and procedural challenge are case-specific; the record does not establish broad institutional or nationwide consequences.
